explain.en: DiffusionBee's data folder: downloaded models, plus your generated images and history. Hoardless only shows the size.
explain.zh: DiffusionBee 的数据文件夹：下载的模型，还有你生成的图片和历史记录。这里只显示大小。

notes: The root is hard-coded (no env override). images/ holds generated output with no other copy. A future review-level sub-rule could target downloaded_assets/ once re-download is confirmed. Not installed on the maintainer's Mac.
